code_snippets:
import pandas as pd
from sqlalchemy import text
import numpy as np

# Query hourly data for October 5, 2025 for all stations
# Photochemical oxidant partitioning ratio = O3 / (O3 + NO2)
query = text("""
SELECT 
    hsaq.station_id,
    aqs.name_en,
    aqs.station_type,
    hsaq.datetime,
    hsaq.o3,
    hsaq.no2,
    CASE 
        WHEN hsaq.o3 IS NOT NULL AND hsaq.no2 IS NOT NULL AND (hsaq.o3 + hsaq.no2) > 0 
        THEN hsaq.o3 / (hsaq.o3 + hsaq.no2)
        ELSE NULL
    END as ox_ratio
FROM hourly_station_air_quality hsaq
JOIN air_quality_station aqs ON hsaq.station_id = aqs.id
WHERE hsaq.datetime >= '2025-10-05 00:00:00'
  AND hsaq.datetime < '2025-10-06 00:00:00'
  AND hsaq.o3 IS NOT NULL
  AND hsaq.no2 IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY aqs.name_en, hsaq.datetime
""")

df = pd.read_sql(query, engine)
print(f"Total records: {len(df)}")
print(f"Stations covered: {df['name_en'].nunique()}")
print(df[['name_en', 'station_type', 'datetime', 'o3', 'no2', 'ox_ratio']].head(20))

# Compute daily average ox_ratio for each station
daily_avg = df.groupby(['name_en', 'station_type'])['ox_ratio'].mean().reset_index()
daily_avg.columns = ['name_en', 'station_type', 'daily_avg_ox_ratio']
daily_avg['daily_avg_ox_ratio'] = daily_avg['daily_avg_ox_ratio'].round(3)

print("Daily average photochemical oxidant partitioning ratio by station:")
print(daily_avg.sort_values('daily_avg_ox_ratio', ascending=False))

# Mean for roadside stations
roadside_mean = daily_avg[daily_avg['station_type'] == 'ROADSIDE']['daily_avg_ox_ratio'].mean()
# Mean for general stations
general_mean = daily_avg[daily_avg['station_type'] == 'GENERAL']['daily_avg_ox_ratio'].mean()

print(f"\nRoadside mean: {roadside_mean:.3f}")
print(f"General mean: {general_mean:.3f}")

# Station with highest ratio
highest_station = daily_avg.loc[daily_avg['daily_avg_ox_ratio'].idxmax()]
print(f"\nHighest ratio station: {highest_station['name_en']}")
print(f"Highest ratio: {highest_station['daily_avg_ox_ratio']:.3f}")

# Store results
roadside_ox_ratio = round(roadside_mean, 3)
general_ox_ratio = round(general_mean, 3)
highest_ox_station = highest_station['name_en']
highest_ox_ratio = round(highest_station['daily_avg_ox_ratio'], 3)

print(f"\nStored values:")
print(f"roadside_ox_ratio: {roadside_ox_ratio}")
print(f"general_ox_ratio: {general_ox_ratio}")
print(f"highest_ox_station: {highest_ox_station}")
print(f"highest_ox_ratio: {highest_ox_ratio}")

# Get Tap Mun station data for October 5, 2025
tap_mun_data = df[df['name_en'] == 'Tap Mun'].copy()
tap_mun_data['hour'] = tap_mun_data['datetime'].dt.hour

# Morning: 06:00-09:00 (hours 6, 7, 8)
morning_data = tap_mun_data[tap_mun_data['hour'].between(6, 8)]
morning_ox = round(morning_data['ox_ratio'].mean(), 3)

# Midday: 11:00-14:00 (hours 11, 12, 13)
midday_data = tap_mun_data[tap_mun_data['hour'].between(11, 13)]
midday_ox = round(midday_data['ox_ratio'].mean(), 3)

# Evening: 17:00-20:00 (hours 17, 18, 19)
evening_data = tap_mun_data[tap_mun_data['hour'].between(17, 19)]
evening_ox = round(evening_data['ox_ratio'].mean(), 3)

print(f"Tap Mun morning (06:00-09:00) ox_ratio: {morning_ox}")
print(f"Tap Mun midday (11:00-14:00) ox_ratio: {midday_ox}")
print(f"Tap Mun evening (17:00-20:00) ox_ratio: {evening_ox}")

print(f"\nAll stored values:")
print(f"roadside_ox_ratio: {roadside_ox_ratio}")
print(f"general_ox_ratio: {general_ox_ratio}")
print(f"highest_ox_station: {highest_ox_station}")
print(f"highest_ox_ratio: {highest_ox_ratio}")
print(f"morning_ox: {morning_ox}")
print(f"midday_ox: {midday_ox}")
print(f"evening_ox: {evening_ox}")
